name: video_archive
title: Video Archive
summary: Searchable grid of every video, each opens in a popup.
description: Archive of the video collection (data_collection_video.json): search, filter by tag and sort by date or title (filters_toolbar look), a grid of thumbnail cards and a popup per video with the player, date, tags, description and buttons. Thumbnails come from data.media.video.video_thumbnail (relative to src/content/img/), with "placeholder" (default thumbnails/video-thumbnail-placeholder.webp) when it is empty or missing. Each video opens from the URL #<video _id>. Options: id, filter.taxonomy.tag, filter._id, search_placeholder, results_text, empty_text, type_label, sort_default, placeholder, popup_width. Texts can also come from a "video-archive" entry in data_collection_listing_toolbar.json.
